children: U.S. trading platform operator's Q3 revenue rose 7% yr/yr
Adjusted EPS for Q3 grew 1% yr/yr
Company declared $1.75 per share special dividend
OTC Markets announces special dividend of $1.75 per share payable December 3, 2026
Company declares fourth-quarter dividend of $0.30 per share payable December 17, 2026
TRADING VOLUMES - OTC Link revenues rose 17% as transaction-based revenues from ECN, NQB, and MOON ATS increased 32% due to higher share volumes
MARKET DATA PRICING - Market Data Licensing revenues increased 7%, driven by price increases for certain licenses and subscriber growth
CORPORATE SERVICES MIX - Corporate Services revenues rose 2% as higher average company counts and price increases in OTCQX and OTCQB offset declines in OTCID and DNS subscribers
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for OTC Markets Group Inc is $65.00, about 24.5% above its November 10 closing price of $52.21
The stock recently traded at 17 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 18 three months ago
